notes.title: Game Updated - Release-Ready Version
notes.content:
After a few months of polish and additional features, the game is ready for release!

Here are a list of updates that have been deployed to the beta and the demo since the previous update news post.

[h1]v0.3.4 - 2 Apr 2025[/h1]
[h3]Settings - VSync Improvements[/h3]
Added ability to set VSync to disabled / every frame / every 2,3, or 4 frames. This is good for higher refresh rate monitors to prevent GPU stress. If your monitor runs at 120Hz or higher, set VSync to every 2 frames to prevent overheating while keeping the game running smooth at 60Hz or above.
[h3]Settings - Target Framerate[/h3]
Added ability to set Target Framerate when VSync is disabled. VSync is generally a smoother experience, but if you must force a specific target frame rate, you can disable VSync and set a target frame rate to 30, 60, 90, 120, or unlimited.
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Score counter on Game Over screen no longer breaks when getting a score over 10 million
[*] Boss no longer accidentally harms player when defeated
[*] 5-second delay introduced before the level destruction continues after you defeat the boss
[*] Ballista bolts now stick to the player, so you can see that you got hit
[*] Flyer enemy ragdolls are now not triggering player melee attacks
[*] You can now melee attack siege weapons (ballista and catapults) and deal damage
[*] Player now runs to the right when holding gamepad thumbstick as the game starts
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ballista bolts and arrows now stick to player ragdoll on death
[*] Lethal catapult fireball is whiter and glows more, while lesser harmful fragments are more orange
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game Over "best of the day" message box widened to fit localization
[*] Fixed Game Over text size that was too large in some languages
[*] Improved sizing of localized tutorial UI  elements
[*] Added missing localization for tutorial activate powerup message
[/list]


[h1]v0.3.3 - 26 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor cinematic camera fixes
[/list]

[h1]v0.3.2 - 25 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed glitchy archer aiming (does best effort if arrow can't reach player)
[*] Menu bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]v0.3.1 - 25 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[*] Fixed possible archer double hit bug

[h1]v0.3.0 - 25 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Cinematic Camera Mode[/h3]
New 3D Cinematic Camera Mode that can be enabled under Settings | Options - this makes it much harder to play, but it offers a unique look. I love playing this mode; it's a new fresh challenge and you have to know the levels well to survive.
[h3]Close Camera Mode[/h3]
New Close camera mode that zooms in on the player - this makes it harder to play, but it shows the characters better. A fun challenge.
[h3]Speedrun Timer[/h3]
You can enable a speedrun timer under Settings | Options .
[h3]One Hit Mode[/h3]
You can enable One Hit mode under Settings | Options that removes the health bar and the player dies upon first hit. This is another challenging way to play the game!
[h3]Statistics[/h3]
The statistics are recorded with camera mode and One Hit mode flags so statistics can be filtered, achievements, and skins can retroactively be tied to historic performances in these modes.
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Generic bug-fixes.
[/list]

[h1]v0.2.62 - 19 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Removed Voicelines[/h3]
Translations were too bad so I removed the localized voice hero lines =)
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Generic bug-fixes.
[/list]

[h1]v0.2.61 - 16 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Localization popup bug-fix.
[/list]

[h1]v0.2.60 - 16 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
The game is now localized into 14 different languages. English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, Italian, Spanish, French, Swedish, Finnish, Russian, Polish, Korean, Japanese, and Portuguese.
The translations will be improved professionally by the publisher.

[h1]v0.2.51 - 11 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]New Skin Select Screen[/h3]
Improved menu screen for selecting skins with more information about how the skins were unlocked.

[h1]v0.2.50 - 11 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Unlockable Skins[/h3]
You can now unlock 20+ player and weapon skins in the game! More skins will be added in updates.

[h1]v0.2.40 - 9 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]Zero Inertia Stopping[/h3]
For even better precise control, there is absolutely no inertia when you release horizontal input now for perfect precision air and ground movement.
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed vertical dead-zone for gamepad input to avoid accidental up-aiming
[/list]

[h1]v0.2.39 - 7 Mar 2025[/h1]
[h3]On Fire Mechanic[/h3]
If you get 11 kills in 5 seconds, you activate  "On Fire" mode, visualized by fire and smoke on and around the hero character. When On Fire is active, kills score double to encourage fast gameplay. If you get hit (without shield) or if you don't get a kill in 5 seconds, On Fire mode is deactivated.
[h3]Ultra Graphics Mode[/h3]
Another "Ultra" quality mode was added which uses depth of field on the background to separate the player and level better from the environment, and it looks nicer =) It also saturates the colors a slight bit more.

[h1]v0.2.30 - 23 Feb 2025[/h1]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved keyboard profiles
[*] Improved multiplayer camera target group framing
[*] General bug-fixes
[/list]

[h1]v0.2.29 - 22 Feb 2025[/h1]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Input profile icon fixes 
[*] HP bar fix
[/list]

[h1]v0.2.28 - 21 Feb 2025[/h1]
[h3]Local Multiplayer[/h3]
You can now play up to 4 players locally in a cooperative mode! If a plyer dies, they respawn as other players reach a bridge.

notes.title: Unfair Rampage: Knightfall - On Fire
notes.content:
[h1]On Fire[/h1]
There are no difficulty levels in Unfair Rampage: Knightfall, but experienced players can elevate the game and score by activating the "On Fire" mode. If you get 11 eliminations within 5 seconds without damage, On Fire is activated, which doubles all elimination scores until you either get hit or until you do not get another elimination within a window of 5 seconds. 

[previewyoutube=ben6LJDxmyM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Ultra Graphics Mode[/h1]
For PC, the new Ultra graphics mode blurs the background environment with depth-of-field, which separates the playable area distinctively from the background, making it easier to distinguish between background and interactive objects.

[previewyoutube=5lMe4O8hyhU;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm also happy to mention that Unfair Rampage: Knightfall will be releasing on Steam and Nintendo Switch at the same time - more information on this will follow shortly =)

Meanwhile, enjoy playing the demo and see if you can reach the boss!

[previewyoutube=udEuMs7v2pU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Local Multiplayer
notes.content:
[h1]Local Multiplayer[/h1]
I'm excited to share that local multiplayer with up to 4 players has now been implemented and it's already available in the demo that you can still play for free! Players can play using controllers and/or keyboard, and there is a keyboard-sharing feature so two players can play using the left/right sides of the keyboard like in the good old days :)

[previewyoutube=FxAYFXd2Tbo;full][/previewyoutube]
In this video, one of the playtesters (thanks Jisilra!) is playing a two-player game and together they reach the first boss encounter! The camera smoothly frames all players up to a certain distance by zooming in and out, and I'm happy local multiplayer is working well.

If one or more players die, they will respawn when a surviving player reaches a bridge so the game isn't over until it's over. As long as one player is still alive, there's always hope!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/e2a3d7da47d6326d043732668df3822ddec93a88.gif[/img]

The local stats take the number of players into account and all stats are summarized based on the number of players. The Steam achievements and leaderboards are only based on single-player stats though. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/5765fd5bca4472a2fb012dd99fd8da033caaf948.gif[/img]

[h1]New Bridges and Level Art[/h1]
The new bridges are also in the game so reaching a bridge will always look fresh and recognizable. The new suspension bridge is my favorite so that became the first bridge to cross!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/251c2a64f6767ae03cdeea72e9c921816e18b8d8.gif[/img]

With the new art, I also reworked the menu to make it a little bit more cozy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/289bed58316a1933ea791b8fe04dd47ea922d1dc.gif[/img]

[h1]Play The Free Demo[/h1]
The DEMO is still available as a FREE download, so enjoy playing the game and see if you can defeat the boss to complete the demo!

notes.title: Local Multiplayer, Co-Op, and Graphics
notes.content:
[h2]FREE DEMO STILL AVAILABLE[/h2]
Steam Next Fest has come and gone, and there were more than 350 platformers featured in this edition of the Next Fest and more than 3000 games in total.

Unfair Rampage: Knightfall is a new game without a historic build-up so the whole event passed below the radar. My goal was/is to release the game in November or December, but it is crucial to build up awareness before the release and while I promote the game I have time to add some more features. The demo is still available for download and I encourage everyone to download and play it!

To promote the game and make a release possible I will be reaching out to content creators, review sites, and indie-related communities, If you want to help speed up the release, please help spread the word (here is a [url=https://impress.games/press-kit/imphenzia/unfair-rampage-knightfall]press-kit[/url])

[h2]NEW BRIDGES[/h2]

This is not yet released to the beta or the demo, but all bridges in the game are now unique. This is a new stone bridge that splits the water and while I was at it, I modelled a little stone hut next to the bridge and it paved the way for more graphical updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/f08901947fecfced46c7841ea5431cf605e79be2.gif[/img]

I also created a suspension bridge and expanding on the idea of the little hut, I made a larger building with a water wheel. In the game, it will be viewed head-on, but for a scenic view, this looks a bit cozier. This is the beauty of making a 2.5D game, different camera angles can be used for menu screens and replays =)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/8e417dc4aaa2f6daa08a5c9a0b1b1f6822e458c3.gif[/img]

This is the simplest-looking bridge, but it also has suspension physics so I can't help but melee attacking enemies onto it. Technically, adding the suspension bridge was a bit complicated because ragdoll corpses on the bridge could easily make it glitch out, but I've found a stable solution now for your enjoyment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/251c2a64f6767ae03cdeea72e9c921816e18b8d8.gif[/img]

[h2]LOCAL MULTIPLAYER[/h2]

I'm also adding local multiplayer with up to 4 players. It should be a fun way to do co-op and see how far you get together, or maybe compete and see who can get the highest score between you. Adding local multiplayer also opens the door and lowers the bar to add networked multiplayer if there is enough interest for that! The camera frames all players now and I don't see any issues adding local multiplayer except quite a large workload to get multiple controllers, UI, and the gameplay adjusted - but it's going great!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/9d2e3e545f3a1a2506057761e426439118304af6.gif[/img]

Since I am reworking the UI for multiplayer, and you'll want to be able to differentiate the characters, skins will also be unlocked as you progress in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/dfb11c2afaebe26ffa103f33741c365a2bd01b52.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and remember to test out the demo if you haven't =)

notes.title: Updates up to v0.2.27
notes.content:
Before and during Steam Next Fest, a bunch of updates were made to improve the game and to fix some minor bugs. Over all the game has been stable to play and the few bugs that exist in the game have been mostly minor cosmetic issues and stats-related.

Here is a summary of the most recent updates:

v0.2.27  - 17 Oct 2024
[list]
[*] Change - Local statistics and Steam statistics are now in sync
[*] Bugfix - Fixed broken statistics where kills would show the wrong type of enemy killed
[/list]

v0.2.26 - 16 Oct 2024
[list]
[*]Bugfix - Ragdoll and mortar improvements (if the mortar can be improved - it may still disappear =)
[*]Bugfix - When starting round 2, the gun wouldn't fire until pressing it, releasing it, and pressing it again
[/list]

v0.2.25 - 15 Oct 2024
[list]
[*]Feature - 1000 more voice lines added for hero and boss
[/list]

v0.2.24 - 14 Oct 2024
[list]
[*]Feature - New spin kick melee attack when you attack an enemy while you are in the air or while dashing (I can not resist adding spinning kicks from my Taekwondo days =)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183494/9a9c3fab8041c4e120f526d36804a70fc9c191e3.gif[/img]

v0.2.23 - 14 Oct 2024
[list]
[*]Bugfix - Mortar kills actually affects your score now. Mortar deals damage to the boss. 
[/list]

v0.2.22 - 13 Oct 2024
[list]
[*]You can now aim with both thumbstick AND Dpad on controllers. 
[*]You can disable aiming with the left thumbstick and Dpad if you have problems with involuntary aiming as you run sideways.
[/list]

v0.2.21 - 13 Oct 2024
[list]
[*] Minor UI bug fixes
[/list]

v0.2.20 - 13 Oct 2024
[list]
[*] New input rebind system, uses the same graphics as in-game tutorials and is more reliable.
[*] No Swedish names of keys in the keyboard remapping settings
[/list]

The demo is still freely available and it has the same bug fixes and improvements as the main game (which is only available in closed beta).

Work continues to make improvements, including bigger features such as local multiplayer, coop and more graphical content.
